name: La Alberca de Záncara (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, green above, light blue below and white at the hoist and fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Alberca de Záncara (a tree on yellow above a pool on green).
history: Municipal flag of La Alberca de Záncara; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
